label: id
comment: A unique identifier (URI) assigned to the product passport. May be a UUID
The globally unique ID of this conformity attestation.
The globally unique ID of the party as a URI, ideall as a resolvable ID.
A unique identifier for the standard (eg https://www.iso.org/standard/60857.html).
A unique identifier for the delcaration. Often this will be an extension of the product.id or attestation.id. But could be a UUID.
The globally unique ID of the product as a URI. Ideall as a resolvable URL according to ISO 18975.
The globally unique ID of the facility as URI, ideally as a resolvable URL.
